children: A whale who bought ETH at $1,647 in early June sold 12,468 ETH at $2,368, earning an estimated $8.99 million in profit, and then shifted to long crude oil positions. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, analyst Ember tracked the whale’s trades, including an initial leveraged ETH purchase worth $30 million. The whale later transferred $20 million in USDC to Hyperliquid; its CL and BRENTOIL long positions are now worth a combined $22.4 million, and the whale is still adding to them.

title: Whale Who Bought ETH at $1,647 Sells 12,468 Tokens for $8.99 Million Profit and Turns to Crude Oil Longs
